proposed.explanation: The investor asked by how much Edita's net profit grew in 2025 compared with 2024, and indicated they would buy more if growth exceeded 50%. The 2024 net profit is verified at 1,606,727,698 EGP (evidence_id EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-31). The 2025 net profit figure (evidence_id EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30) is marked AMBIGUOUS because the scanned page has a stamp covering the 2025 value, making it unreliable. Per the rules, AMBIGUOUS figures must not be used in calculations and should be listed as unused. Consequently, there is not enough reliable evidence to compute the percentage growth or to determine whether it exceeds 50%. Therefore the recommendation is insufficient_evidence; no buy or sell action can be responsibly taken based on the provided data.
limitations: 2025 net profit figure is ambiguous and cannot be used; only 2024 figure is verified.
